kind: controlled repeated CLI crossover with exact-session audits
regradeMethod: Regrade all 27 retained trials using common strengthened hidden checks, original completion/model/usage telemetry, and exact-session scope/effort audits. No model retries, workspace repairs, or modified task prompts. Original suite artifacts remain unchanged.
conditions: Sequential crossover schedule on one machine. Each agent occupies each position once. Run no other lab provider calls, builds, or Electron tests during this schedule. User activity, provider load, and cache warmth are not controlled.
sourceConditions: Primary app/build/source fixed at e9c710af. Only benchmark-generated history changed in the primary checkout; report drafts stayed in a separate worktree. No overlapping paid lab calls, product builds, or test suites. Default 256000 compaction threshold; fast mode off.
limitations: The original patch oracle missed the stated dash-path restriction and own JSON __proto__ addition. A validated common grader was applied offline to all 27 retained solutions, without task prompt changes, model retries, workspace repairs, or modified task files. Original automated checks and timing/usage are preserved.
Three repetitions per task/harness, one machine, one model/effort; no universal ranking or causal reliability estimate.
Shared provider subscription, load, cache warmth, and user activity are uncontrolled. Tasks are repeated development contracts, not fresh blind holdouts.
Installed Hermes is the recorded local fork, not stock upstream. Claude Code account unavailable and excluded, not counted as a Cora win.

Acceptance retains every attempted trial, including operational failures. Performance cohorts contain identical round/task blocks where the listed harnesses all passed. Latency includes all recovered-request time; token comparisons also exclude known unmetered retries. This conditions efficiency on joint success and, for tokens, telemetry availability; failures remain in acceptance totals.

Tokens include input, output, cache reads and cache writes and are not dollar costs. Timed-out provider requests may consume unreported tokens; incomplete trial totals are explicitly marked. usageComplete means no missing usage was identified in the recorded provider/retry evidence; it is not a billing audit.
